description_en: Modifies the association between a specified ApsaraDB RDS instance and ECS security groups
description_zh: 该接口用于修改指定RDS实例和ECS安全组的关联信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-security-group-configuration --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --security-group-id sg-0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySecurityGroupConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ECS security group ID. You can associate up to 10 security groups with an instance. Separate multiple security group IDs with commas (,). To disassociate all ECS security groups, pass an empty string. You can call DescribeSecurityGroups to query ECS security group IDs
parameters.help_zh: ECS安全组ID。最多支持关联10个安全组，多个安全组用英文逗号（,）隔开。清空ECS安全组请传入空字符串。您可以通过DescribeSecurityGroups查询ECS安全组ID
parameters.name: security_group_id

EcsSecurityGroupRelation.description_en: The list of associated security group information
EcsSecurityGroupRelation.description_zh: 关联的安全组信息列表

items.description_en: The details of the associated security group
items.description_zh: 关联的安全组信息详情

NetworkType.description_en:
The network type of the ECS security group. Valid values:
Classic: classic network.
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC)
NetworkType.description_zh:
ECS安全组的网络类型。取值：
Classic：经典网络
VPC：专有网络
